    Lifted mesh sequences over a positive deformation (toward Corollary 12.1) #

    deformation-refinements.tex (cor:positive-deformation-completeness). Let B be a positive filtered deformation of A₀ and M_X^B the filtered lifts of the evaluated modules (Proposition 6.5). Lifting the mesh maps gives, at a nonprojective x, a surjection π : ⊕_a M_{y_a}^B → M_x^B whose leading term is the graded mesh map, with kernel the image of an injective B-linear map M_{τx}^B → ⊕_a M_{y_a}^B (the kernel is a filtered lift of M_{τx}, by uniqueness of lifts); at a projective x, π is injective. These are the lifted almost split sequences of ind(mod B).
